metadata.description: Dotted import path to a Python class, method or function to inspect (e.g. 'collections.OrderedDict', 'json.JSONEncoder', 'datetime.datetime.fromtimestamp'). May also be an alias key resolved through 'type_mapping'.
Dictionary of parameters/keyword arguments to validate against the target's signature. Filtered to accepted parameters, with missing required parameters filled and values coerced to expected types.
Optional dictionary carrying alias->dotted-path entries (to resolve 'target') and/or param_name->type-hint entries ('int'|'float'|'str'|'bool'|'list'|'dict') used to coerce specific config values.
If true, instantiate/call the target with the validated params to confirm acceptance. Defaults to false (signature-only inspection).
If true, enables debug logging at each processing step. Defaults to false.
Optional dictionary of environment variable overrides to apply at runtime.
